import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Set the style of seaborn
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a FacetGrid bar plot to compare the average sleep duration by BMI Category and Gender
g = sns.catplot(
    data=df,
    x="BMI Category",
    y="Sleep Duration",
    hue="Gender",
    kind="bar",
    height=6,
    aspect=1.5,
    palette="muted"
)

# Add labels and title
g.set_axis_labels("BMI Category", "Average Sleep Duration (hours)")
g.fig.suptitle("Average Sleep Duration by BMI Category and Gender", fontsize=16)
g.add_legend(title="Gender")

# Rotate x-axis labels for better readability
plt.xticks(rotation=45)

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Set the style of seaborn
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a FacetGrid bar plot to compare the average sleep duration by BMI Category and Gender
g = sns.catplot(
    data=df,
    x="BMI Category",
    y="Sleep Duration",
    hue="Gender",
    kind="bar",
    height=6,
    aspect=1.5,
    palette="muted"
)

# Add labels and title
g.set_axis_labels("BMI Category", "Average Sleep Duration (hours)")
g.fig.suptitle("Average Sleep Duration by BMI Category and Gender", fontsize=16)
g.add_legend(title="Gender")

# Rotate x-axis labels for better readability
plt.xticks(rotation=45)

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
